name: Fukushima

flag.description: A white hiragana ふ (fu) curled into a ring, set toward the hoist on an orange field.
flag.symbolism: ふ is the first sound of Fukushima, rounded for unity and steady progress; its designer said she also drew it as a peach.

hook: Fukushima's white ふ (fu) curls into a peach-shaped ring on orange; Nagano's white disc on orange is cut by curves.
trivia: Fukushima is the third-largest prefecture by area, after Hokkaido and Iwate.
It is one of Japan's leading peach growers.
